transcript: I think that most of the important values were already represented, but I do say that there wasn't my perfect society from the options listed. I think the closest one that came to it was the modern green society or utopia that focused on sustainability. Um, but I think if I could take that and keep the, um, ability for people to kind of have a little bit of, um, choices and decisions in the sustainability measures that they take to help keep the society running, I think, um, I didn't, wasn't a fan of the just enough portion of it. I think that people should be able to live a little bit more than just the bare necessities in bare minimum beyond their needs. So if the rules can be a little bit lax on, you know, making sure everybody only has just enough and also maybe incorporating a little bit more slightly stricter governing laws just so that the society isn't a complete free-for-all and that there are rules to abide by, but that the primary focus still stays for sustainability measures.
